findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_forecast" stacks urgency/override words (important, always). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tariff_index, rank_landed_cost, reshoring_score, get_tariff_bill, get_policy_premium, get_tariff_dollars_by_country, get_source_shift, get_tariff_effect, get_sourcing_diversification, get_import_price_movers, get_duty_free_routes, get_wage_board, get_forecast, get_forecast_accuracy, get_cost_pressure_index, get_input_cost_diffusion, get_supply_chain_fragility, get_state_cost_index, get_cost_pass_through, get_manufacturing_pmi, get_reshoring_break_even, get_tariff_action_ledger, get_provenance, get_eti_outlook, search_site · Private data: get_forecast, get_forecast_accuracy, get_tariff_action_ledger, get_provenance · Public sink: rank_landed_cost, get_source_shift, get_forecast_accuracy, get_input_cost_diffusion, get_supply_chain_fragility, get_eti_outlook · Destructive: run_calculator, get_forecast_accuracy, get_manufacturing_pmi, get_provenance, ask.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tariff_index, rank_landed_cost, reshoring_score, get_tariff_bill, get_policy_premium, get_tariff_dollars_by_country, get_source_shift, get_tariff_effect, get_sourcing_diversification, get_import_price_movers, get_duty_free_routes, get_wage_board, get_forecast, get_forecast_accuracy, get_cost_pressure_index, get_input_cost_diffusion, get_supply_chain_fragility, get_state_cost_index, get_cost_pass_through, get_manufacturing_pmi, get_reshoring_break_even, get_tariff_action_ledger, get_provenance, get_eti_outlook, search_site · Private data: get_forecast, get_forecast_accuracy, get_tariff_action_ledger, get_provenance · Public sink: rank_landed_cost, get_source_shift, get_forecast_accuracy, get_input_cost_diffusion, get_supply_chain_fragility, get_eti_outlook · Destructive: run_calculator, get_forecast_accuracy, get_manufacturing_pmi, get_provenance, ask

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
